description:
Music video directed and animated by Kouhei Kadowaki for the song Comet by YOASOBI.

Note: This song, and the first part of the music video, was originally used as the ending theme in BEASTARS 2nd Season. There exists two versions of this music video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on February 25, 2021 and an English version of the song titled "Comet" also by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 11, 2021.
